question.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1}$, ${a}_{2}$, and $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$ from the decomposition $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
We know that $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}$ if there exist ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=2 \\ 2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=0 \\ -3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-7\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 & 0 \\ -3 & 1 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & -4 \\ -3 & 1 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=2 \\ {x}_{2}=-1 \\ 0=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Since the system has a solution, we can conclude that $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}.$

Moreover, there is exactly one solution, so we have exactly one way to write $b$ as a linear combination of ${a}_{1}$ and ${a}_{2}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2{a}_{1}+(-1){a}_{2} & =b \\ 2\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+(-1)\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}=2\cdot (-1)=-2.$
